adjustment.rationale: The initial solve and three physical-parameter replays share one test deadline. Four same-sized solves at the repeatedly observed 47-51 second waits are expected to exceed 180 seconds; 360 seconds leaves room for unchanged image checks and playback. The desktop setup already took about eight minutes, while the latest successful main desktop browser step took about sixteen minutes, so the complete job needs space for this additional feedback case.
